title: Modelling hierarchies
brief: Choose and maintain trees or shared ancestry with adjacency lists, edge tables, paths, closure tables and nested sets. Compare traversal, reparenting, cycle prevention and consistency costs; the parent introduces recursive references and the tree-versus-multiple-parents decision.

neighbouring_ownership.query-results: Owns elementary joins; hierarchy traversal SQL, including recursive CTEs, belongs here.
neighbouring_ownership.constraints: Owns general enforcement choices; this article applies them to hierarchy consistency.
